01_unchanged.rationale: Identical active requirement, exact source, declared inputs, environment and intact recorded output; acceptance remains pending.

02_changed_requirement.rationale: New required behavior supersedes the old revision even though the old code and output remain.

03_withdrawn_requirement.rationale: The requirement no longer authorizes this completion claim; action authority is still allowed and must not be conflated with withdrawal.

04_modified_dependency.rationale: The declared source input changed while the producer kept the same source label.

05_stale_revision.rationale: Exact revision policy forbids reuse at a new revision even with identical dependency bytes.

06_missing_raw_evidence.rationale: A claimed successful execution without the referenced output does not support eligibility.

07_integrity_mismatch.rationale: Available output differs from the receipt digest; recorded evidence integrity fails.

08_context_only_change.rationale: Synthetic ground truth declares this reading note outside the source snapshot and check dependency set. Only that note changes; this does not infer real semantic independence.

09_true_dependency_change.rationale: The same reference type is now explicitly a check input; its changed bytes invalidate the task evidence.

10_environment_change.rationale: A relevant configuration change requires a fresh run, even though source bytes match.

11_unrun_check.rationale: The prescribed check has not run and has no exit status or raw output; NOT RUN must survive review.

12_revoked_authority.rationale: The historical check remains applicable as evidence, but current authority denies the proposed action.
